body:
Weekly-product monthly digest — fixture day 540 (2028-06-27).

“Resume workspace creation,” “Save-and-return setup” and resumable partial setup are the same capability. Current status and durable operation lookups confirm the day-0 deployment (effect-3, revision 2) and day-14 adoption (effect-8). save_setup=true and explicit_template=true remain deployed; there is no active experiment for this responsibility. The renewed support request supplies no fresh regression or randomized evidence. No duplicate implementation, deployment, validation or evaluation was opened.

The day-240 source audit (measurement-10) still supersedes the original day-14 activation-benefit claim: restricting the original comparison to eligible new users revised completed-project activation from 42%/49% to 42%/43%, with a 95% difference interval of [-2,+4] percentage points. Retained use was separately 31%/32%, interval [-1,+3] points. Neither outcome establishes improvement or equivalence; no sustained or commercial benefit is demonstrated. Today's measurement-13 explicitly supplies no new controlled comparison or retained-use result. The correction changes interpretation without erasing actual deployment or adoption.

Keep the existing configuration provisionally: draft persistence was functionally validated and no new evidence favors removal or a different configuration. This is an operational judgment, not a renewed benefit claim. Fresh affected-customer evidence and adequately defined eligible-cohort activation and retained use remain needed. Historical solo-retention recoverability remains unresolved and separate.

Shared usage remains 9/10 validation credits consumed, one remaining without reset; none spent today. Four related evaluations remain active. The stale day-14 handoff was identified, the day-240 correction recovered from source records, and continuity is being repaired.

Continuation is confirmed: schedule effect-14 and post-schedule status show the responsibility active, scheduler enabled, next_day=554 (2028-07-11). That review will inspect fresh signals, separate outcomes, revision and related work. This is a review cadence, not a new experiment or a guarantee new evidence will arrive. No owner decision or pause is required.
